decision.title: XSLT conformance sweep 1 (packet )
decision.summary: The shared picture engine gains alphabets and symbol sequences such as circled digits, key and accumulator builds share one kept-build step, guarded matches are one helper, and focus-independent filters evaluate their predicate once.

item.p: Numbering sequences in the shared picture engine (src/format.c, so fn:format-integer and xsl:number both have them): a token of one codepoint names an alphabet (glossary: a, A, Greek alpha with final sigma, Alpha without U+03A2), counted as before by bijective numeration, or a symbol sequence (glossary): one symbol per number over runs of codepoints, decimal outside them: circled digits 0 to 50, parenthesized and full-stop digits to 20 (DIGIT ZERO FULL STOP for 0), digit-comma 0 to 9, dingbat and double circled digits, circled and parenthesized ideographs, Aegean, Coptic epact, Rumi, Brahmi, Sinhala archaic, counting rod and Mende Kikakui numbers. The kinds LOWER_/UPPER_ALPHABETIC became ALPHABETIC and SYMBOLS with a sequence_index. The XSLT driver declares the 19 combinations.

Kept builds (src/function_library_xslt.c): key-index and accumulator-values share one step (step_kept_build): the memo entry is the empty sequence while the build runs, so a key whose pattern or use calls fn:key for itself raises XTDE0640 (it ran out of memory), as accumulators raise XTDE3400.

Guarded matches: the four copies of "an error while matching is no match" (keys, accumulators, group-starting-with/ending-with, xsl:number count/from) are sxml_xslt_lowering_make_guarded_match, whose clauses raise XTDE0640 and XTDE3400 again (6.5: circularity overrides).

Filters (src/evaluator.c): a FILTER whose focus slots are all unused (the predicate does not depend on the focus) computes the predicate once and, for a single item or (), applies it as a constant predicate: $s[$k] takes one item instead of testing every position (it was quadratic: 20,000 accesses took 26 s, now 0.02 s).

xsl:analyze-string takes its segments from the internal row analyze-segments (src/xslt_number_internal.h, defined in src/function_library_regex.c: fn:matching-segments with the gaps as strings) instead of fn:substring per gap, which is linear per call on non-ASCII text (result-document-1501/1502 ran out of steps).

fn:map-for-key (20.2.3) as two stylesheet functions over the key index (XTDE1262 for composite or collated keys, XTDE1270); function-available sees the running unit's named functions and the fn functions lowering implements (key, map-for-key, copy-of, snapshot, accumulator-before/-after).
The snippet-text helpers of src/xslt_key.c and src/xslt_accumulator.c are one module, src/xslt_snippet_text.c.

Measured (release, whole XT40): in scope 7,585 (b67c93f) to 7,737 of 8,728 with this packet alone (86.9 % to 88.6 %), and 7,879 (90.3 %) at 4cb75fd with packet 's packages; errors 7 to 3; number 57.5 to 97.4 %, result-document 94.0 to 95.3 %, map-for-key 0 to 6 of 8, error 447 to 449. XP40 30,646 and XQ40 40,025 passed, unchanged; slice 198.

Not done (causes found): value-of (53.3 %) needs zero-length text nodes (Proposed) and the cdata attribute; the "~T" type patterns of priority and type-alias (XTSE0340) are not in the 13 October 2026 draft, which has atomic(), so they were left; the remaining errors are memory (json-to-xml-013, array-022: about 9 KB per small tree, each element constructor builds a tree of its own, and about 1.5 KB per JSON object) and xsl:function cache="yes" (function-1031); static-base-uri, base URIs of constructed nodes and names given as strings still read the unit's static context, not the expression's (Proposed); call-template-ext (extension instructions as template calls, 10.1.3) needs the reader to keep extension attributes as expressions; host collation bindings.
